category: Filters IV - Texture and Distort gallery effects, Blur Gallery tools and Neural Filters
description: Completes the per-filter coverage: the Filter Gallery Texture, Distort and Stylize members, each Blur Gallery blur with its on-canvas widget and the shared Effects/Motion Effects/Noise tabs, and the individual Neural Filters that the 'Neural Filters' overview only names.

tools.name: Craquelure
tools.description: Paints the image onto a high-relief plaster surface and cracks it into a fine network, emphasising contours. Effective for aged fresco and antique-photo looks.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Texture > Craquelure
tools.example: Filter Gallery > Texture > Craquelure: Spacing 15, Depth 6, Brightness 9 on a Smart Object, then fade to 50 %.
tools.notes: 8-bit RGB/Grayscale only, like every gallery effect.

tools.name: Grain (Filter Gallery)
tools.description: Adds ten different kinds of grain (Regular, Soft, Sprinkles, Clumped, Contrasty, Enlarged, Stippled, Horizontal, Vertical, Speckle) with intensity and contrast sliders. Horizontal/Vertical give scan-line and streak effects that Add Noise cannot.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Texture > Grain

parameters.name: Grain Type
parameters.description: Regular, Soft, Sprinkles, Clumped, Contrasty, Enlarged, Stippled, Horizontal, Vertical, Speckle.

tools.example: Filter Gallery > Texture > Grain: Intensity 40, Contrast 50, Type Soft.
tools.notes: Distinct from the non-destructive Grain adjustment layer added in Photoshop 27.3 (see 'Grain (adjustment layer)').

tools.name: Mosaic Tiles
tools.description: Renders the image as small irregular tiles separated by grout, like a bathroom mosaic. Unlike Pixelate > Mosaic the tiles keep the image detail inside them.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Texture > Mosaic Tiles
tools.example: Filter Gallery > Texture > Mosaic Tiles: Tile Size 12, Grout Width 3, Lighten Grout 9.
tools.notes: Stained Glass gives a similar cell structure with flat colours.

tools.name: Patchwork
tools.description: Breaks the image into squares filled with the predominant colour of each area and randomly raises or lowers them to suggest a quilt or beadwork.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Texture > Patchwork
tools.example: Filter Gallery > Texture > Patchwork: Square Size 4, Relief 8.
tools.notes: Square Size is relative, so results depend on image resolution.

tools.name: Stained Glass
tools.description: Repaints the image as single-coloured adjacent cells outlined with leading in the foreground colour, with an optional back-light glow. Works like Crystallize plus borders.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Texture > Stained Glass
tools.example: Foreground black, Filter Gallery > Texture > Stained Glass: Cell Size 10, Border 4, Light 3.
tools.notes: The lead colour is the foreground swatch.

tools.name: Texturizer
tools.description: Embosses a texture (Brick, Burlap, Canvas, Sandstone or any grey-scale .psd you load) into the image with adjustable scale, relief and light direction. The standard way to add canvas or paper grain to painterly conversions, and usable on its own for subtle paper texture.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Texture > Texturizer   |   ArtLayer.applyTextureFill(file) for the Texture Fill plug-in

parameters.name: Texture
parameters.description: Brick, Burlap, Canvas, Sandstone, or Load Texture... (.psd file).

parameters.name: Light
parameters.description: Direction menu; Invert flips high and low.

tools.example: Filter Gallery > Texture > Texturizer: Texture Canvas, Scaling 100 %, Relief 4, Light Top Left.
tools.notes: Load any flattened grey-scale .psd as a custom texture; the same loader appears in Rough Pastels, Underpainting, Conte Crayon and Glass.

tools.name: Diffuse Glow
tools.description: Renders the image as if seen through a soft diffusion filter, adding white noise and a glow that fades from the centre of highlights outward using the background colour. Classic for dreamy portrait and high-key looks.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Distort > Diffuse Glow   |   ArtLayer.applyDiffuseGlow(graininess, glowAmount, clearAmount)

parameters.name: Clear Amount
parameters.description: 0-20; higher protects more of the image from the glow.

tools.example:
app.backgroundColor.rgb.hexValue = "FFFFFF";
app.activeDocument.activeLayer.applyDiffuseGlow(2, 6, 15);
tools.notes: The glow colour is the background swatch; set it to white for a normal glow. UXP: `layer.applyDiffuseGlow(graininess, glowAmount, clearAmount)`.

tools.name: Glass
tools.description: Refracts the image as if viewed through textured glass (Blocks, Canvas, Frosted, Tiny Lens or a loaded .psd), with distortion, smoothness and scaling controls. Also used with a custom displacement-like texture for water-drop and privacy-glass effects.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Distort > Glass   |   ArtLayer.applyGlassEffect(distortion, smoothness, scaling, invert, texture, textureFile)

parameters.name: Texture
parameters.description: Blocks, Canvas, Frosted, Tiny Lens, or Load Texture (.psd).

parameters.name: Scaling
parameters.description: 50-200 %; Invert flips the relief.

tools.example: app.activeDocument.activeLayer.applyGlassEffect(8, 3, 100, false, TextureType.FROSTED);
tools.notes: UXP: `layer.applyGlassEffect(distortion, smoothness, scaling, invert, texture, textureFile)`.

tools.name: Ocean Ripple
tools.description: Adds randomly spaced ripples so the image appears to be under water. Ripple Size sets the wavelength and Ripple Magnitude the displacement strength.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Distort > Ocean Ripple   |   ArtLayer.applyOceanRipple(size, magnitude)
tools.example: app.activeDocument.activeLayer.applyOceanRipple(9, 9);
tools.notes: For directional waves use Filter > Distort > Wave. UXP: `layer.applyOceanRipple(size, magnitude)`.

tools.name: Glowing Edges
tools.description: Identifies colour edges and adds a neon-like glow to them on a black background, an adjustable version of Find Edges + Invert. Used for light-painting, sci-fi outline and 'Tron' effects.
tools.usage: Filter > Filter Gallery > Stylize > Glowing Edges
tools.example: Filter Gallery > Stylize > Glowing Edges: Width 2, Brightness 6, Smoothness 5, then set the layer to Screen over the original.
tools.notes: The only Stylize filter that lives inside the gallery.

tools.name: Field Blur
tools.description: Blur Gallery tool that places one or more pins, each with its own blur amount, and interpolates the blur smoothly between them - a gradient depth-of-field without a mask. Pins at 0 px keep areas sharp; pins at 100+ px turn backgrounds to bokeh. Selection edges can be feathered from the options bar.
tools.usage: Filter > Blur Gallery > Field Blur...

parameters.name: Pin / Blur
parameters.description: Click to add pins; drag the ring or the Blur slider (0-500 px) per pin. Alt-drag duplicates a pin, Delete removes it.

parameters.name: Selection Bleed / Focus / Save Mask to Channels
parameters.description: Options-bar controls for how a pre-existing selection interacts with the blur and to export the blur mask.

parameters.name: High Quality
parameters.description: Slower, more accurate bokeh rendering.

tools.example:
1. Filter > Convert for Smart Filters.
2. Filter > Blur Gallery > Field Blur; the default pin is 15 px.
3. Click on the subject and set its pin to 0 px; click far background, set 60 px.
4. Open the Effects tab, Light Bokeh 30 %, Light Range 200-255; press OK.
tools.notes: Works with 8/16-bit RGB/CMYK/Lab; GPU accelerated. Multiple Blur Gallery blurs can be enabled at once from the Blur Tools panel checkboxes.

tools.name: Iris Blur
tools.description: Simulates a shallow depth of field with an elliptical (or rounded-rectangular) sharp zone that falls off to the chosen blur outside it, controlled entirely by an on-canvas widget. Ideal for fake tilt-shift portraits and product isolation.
tools.usage: Filter > Blur Gallery > Iris Blur...

parameters.name: Ellipse handles
parameters.description: Drag the outer ring to size, the handle square to change roundness, the four inner feather points (Alt-drag one to move it alone) to set where blur starts.

parameters.name: Blur
parameters.description: 0-500 px outside the ellipse.

parameters.name: Focus
parameters.description: Options bar, 0-100 %: sharpness inside the sharp zone.

tools.example: Filter > Blur Gallery > Iris Blur: drag the ellipse over the face, Blur 25 px, pull the feather points inward slightly, OK.
tools.notes: Combine with Field Blur pins for a more natural gradient; combine with Path Blur for motion.

tools.name: Tilt-Shift
tools.description: Applies a band of sharpness bounded by two solid lines, with blur ramping up beyond the dashed feather lines, imitating a tilt-shift lens or the 'miniature model' look on cityscapes. Distortion can be added to the lower blur to fake lens bokeh stretch.
tools.usage: Filter > Blur Gallery > Tilt-Shift...

parameters.name: Solid / dashed lines
parameters.description: Drag the solid lines to size the sharp band, the dashed lines to set feathering, the pin handle to rotate.

parameters.name: Distortion / Symmetric Distortion
parameters.description: -100 to 100 % bokeh stretch in the blur zone; Symmetric applies to both sides.

tools.example: Filter > Blur Gallery > Tilt-Shift on an aerial city photo: Blur 30 px, narrow the sharp band to the street level, then Image > Adjustments > Vibrance +40 for the toy look.
tools.notes: For real perspective control of architecture use the Perspective Crop tool or Camera Raw's Geometry panel instead.

tools.name: Path Blur
tools.description: Creates motion blur along one or more user-drawn paths, with per-endpoint speed, taper, and an optional rear-sync flash strobe effect. Unlike Motion Blur the direction can curve and vary across the image, so vehicles, running figures and light trails can be blurred realistically.
tools.usage: Filter > Blur Gallery > Path Blur...

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: Click to add points, drag to curve, Ctrl-drag to move; each endpoint has a red speed arrow.

parameters.name: Basic Blur / Rear Sync Flash
parameters.description: Blur type: plain motion or flash-frozen strobe.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: 0-500 % overall blur amount.

parameters.name: Taper
parameters.description: 0-100 % fades the blur at the ends.

parameters.name: Centered Blur
parameters.description: Keeps the blur centred on the pixel (stable shapes) rather than trailing.

parameters.name: End Point Speed / Edit Blur Shapes
parameters.description: Per-endpoint control and visibility of the blur shape guides.

tools.example: Filter > Blur Gallery > Path Blur: draw a path along a cyclist's direction of travel, Speed 120 %, Taper 20 %, tick Centered Blur, then mask the cyclist out of the blur with the Smart Filter mask.
tools.notes: Motion Effects tab (Strobe Strength, Strobe Flashes, Strobe Flash Duration) applies to Path and Spin Blur.

tools.name: Spin Blur
tools.description: Applies a rotational blur around an elliptical on-canvas widget, for spinning wheels, propellers and turntables, with a Blur Angle in degrees and optional strobe flashes. Move the rotation centre with Alt-drag to fit wheels photographed at an angle.
tools.usage: Filter > Blur Gallery > Spin Blur...

parameters.name: Ellipse and rotation centre
parameters.description: Drag the ring to size, handle to reshape; Alt-drag the centre to offset it.

parameters.name: Blur Angle
parameters.description: 0-360 degrees of rotational blur.

parameters.name: Feather points
parameters.description: Inner ring where the blur begins to fade.

tools.example: Filter > Blur Gallery > Spin Blur: place the ellipse over the car wheel, Blur Angle 20 degrees, add a second ellipse over the other wheel, OK.
tools.notes: Combines well with Path Blur on the background for a panning shot.

tools.name: Blur Gallery Effects, Motion Effects and Noise tabs
tools.description: The three tabs beside the Blur Tools panel that refine every Blur Gallery result: Effects controls the bokeh highlights, Motion Effects adds strobe flashes to Path and Spin blurs, and Noise re-introduces grain so blurred areas match the unblurred ones. Restoring noise is the step most people forget and the reason gallery blurs look 'plastic'.
tools.usage: Filter > Blur Gallery > (any) > Effects / Motion Effects / Noise tabs

parameters.name: Effects > Light Bokeh
parameters.description: 0-100 % brightening of out-of-focus highlights.

parameters.name: Effects > Bokeh Color
parameters.description: 0-100 % saturation boost of the bokeh.

parameters.name: Effects > Light Range
parameters.description: Two-handle slider (0-255) selecting which tonal values become bokeh.

parameters.name: Motion Effects > Strobe Strength / Strobe Flashes / Flash Duration
parameters.description: Strobe amount 0-100 %, number of flashes 1-100, duration in degrees or px.

parameters.name: Noise > Amount / Size / Roughness / Color / Highlights
parameters.description: Gaussian, Uniform or Grain noise matched to the source; Amount 0-100 %, Size 0-100 %, Roughness -100 to 100 %, Color 0-100 %, Highlights 0-100 %.

tools.example: After setting a Field Blur, open Noise: type Grain, Amount 20 %, Size 30 %, Roughness 40 % so the blurred sky keeps the same grain as the sharp foreground.
tools.notes: Effects tab is disabled for Path/Spin blur; Motion Effects only for Path/Spin.

tools.name: Smart Portrait (Neural Filter)
tools.description: Machine-learning portrait editor that synthesises changes to facial expression (Happiness, Surprise, Anger), Facial Age, Hair Thickness, Gaze, Head Direction and Light Direction, blending the generated face back onto the photo. Use for subtle expression tweaks and light relighting; large values produce artefacts and visible generation seams.
tools.usage: Filter > Neural Filters... > Portraits > Smart Portrait

parameters.name: Featured: Happiness / Surprise / Anger
parameters.description: -50 to 50 expression sliders.

parameters.name: Gaze / Head Direction
parameters.description: Eye direction and head yaw sliders.

parameters.name: Light Direction
parameters.description: Relights the face from left/right.

parameters.name: Global: Retain Unique Details / Mask Feathering
parameters.description: Preserve identity details; soften the blend mask.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Current Layer, New Layer, New Layer Masked, Smart Filter or New Document.

tools.example:
1. Filter > Neural Filters, enable Smart Portrait (download on first use).
2. Set Happiness +15, Light Direction +20, Retain Unique Details 60.
3. Output: New Layer, OK, then lower the layer opacity to taste.
tools.notes: Cloud-processed (requires sign-in and internet); results are marked with Content Credentials when enabled. Faces must be reasonably frontal and larger than ~256 px.

tools.name: JPEG Artifacts Removal (Neural Filter)
tools.description: Removes 8x8 block edges, ringing and colour bleeding from heavily compressed JPEGs using a trained model, with a single Strength control. Use on web downloads, old camera files and screenshots before retouching or enlarging.
tools.usage: Filter > Neural Filters... > Restoration > JPEG Artifacts Removal

parameters.name: Strength
parameters.description: Low, Medium or High.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Current Layer, New Layer, New Layer Masked, Smart Filter, New Document.

tools.example: Open a 60 % quality JPEG, Filter > Neural Filters > JPEG Artifacts Removal, Strength Medium, output to Smart Filter, then Super Zoom if enlarging.
tools.notes: Runs on-device (GPU); slow on large images. Pair with Photo Restoration for scanned prints.

tools.name: Makeup Transfer (Neural Filter)
tools.description: Copies the eye and lip makeup style from a reference portrait (any open document or a chosen file) onto the current portrait. Use it to match beauty looks across a shoot; it does not alter skin tone or hair.
tools.usage: Filter > Neural Filters... > Portraits > Makeup Transfer

parameters.name: Reference Image
parameters.description: Choose an open document or click to select an image file.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Current Layer, New Layer, New Layer Masked, Smart Filter, New Document.

tools.example: Open the reference portrait and the target, select the target, Filter > Neural Filters > Makeup Transfer, pick the reference from the menu, output New Layer Masked.
tools.notes: Cloud processed. Best with frontal faces of similar size.

tools.name: Color Transfer (Neural Filter)
tools.description: Transfers the colour palette of a reference image (preset thumbnails or a custom image) onto the current one, optionally preserving luminance, with sliders for brightness, saturation and hue balance. A fast grading tool for matching composites or copying a film look.
tools.usage: Filter > Neural Filters... > Color > Color Transfer

parameters.name: Preset / Custom reference
parameters.description: Choose a preset thumbnail or a custom image (file or open document).

parameters.name: Preserve Luminance
parameters.description: Keep the original brightness and change colour only.

parameters.name: Color Space
parameters.description: Lab or RGB matching model.

parameters.name: Brightness / Saturation / Hue / Balance
parameters.description: Post-transfer fine tuning.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Current Layer, New Layer, New Layer Masked, Smart Filter, New Document.

tools.example: Filter > Neural Filters > Color Transfer: Custom > choose the hero shot, tick Preserve Luminance, Saturation -10, output Smart Filter.
tools.notes: Image > Adjustments > Match Color is the older, non-ML equivalent and works offline.

tools.name: Neural Filters workspace and output options
tools.description: The Neural Filters panel groups filters into Portraits, Creative, Color, Photography and Restoration, with Featured, Beta and Wait list tabs, per-filter download toggles (models are downloaded on first use), a before/after preview and a common Output menu. Beta filters are experimental and their sliders or availability change between releases; Wait list entries are previews you can vote for.
tools.usage: Filter > Neural Filters...

parameters.name: Featured / Beta / Wait list
parameters.description: Release status tabs. Featured (stable): Skin Smoothing, Smart Portrait, Makeup Transfer, Landscape Mixer, Style Transfer, Harmonization, Color Transfer, Colorize, Super Zoom, Depth Blur, JPEG Artifacts Removal, Photo Restoration.

parameters.name: Download cloud icon
parameters.description: Fetches the model for a filter; greyed filters have not been downloaded.

parameters.name: Show original / Preview toggle
parameters.description: Compare before and after.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Current Layer, New Layer, New Layer Masked, Smart Filter (requires Smart Object), New Document.

parameters.name: Feedback thumbs
parameters.description: Send results to Adobe to improve the models.

tools.example: Filter > Neural Filters; on the Beta tab enable a beta filter such as Photo to Sketch, judge the preview, then set Output to New Layer so the original stays intact.
tools.notes: Some filters run on-device (GPU) and others in the cloud; cloud filters need internet and a signed-in Creative Cloud account. Requires Photoshop 22.0 or later; Neural Filters are unavailable in 32-bit documents.
